text: [351] 80 chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu na cirasseva mahattaṃ 2 vepullattaṃ pāpuṇāti dhammesu katamehi chahi idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ālokabahulo ca hoti yogabahulo ca hoti 3 vedabahulo ca hoti 3 asantuṭṭhibahulo ca anikkhittadhuro ca kusalesu dhammesu uttariñca patāreti imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu na cirasseva mahattaṃ 2 vepullattaṃ pāpuṇāti dhammesūti .
